auction.inventory: displayed depth-one additions/removals; removal less executions is an estimate, not identified cancels
auction.response: difference of first/last quarter-window execution VWAP; efficiency divided by window range

calendar.interpretation: reconstruction calendar assumption, not newly recovered CME schedule evidence
calendar.model: regular NQ schedule with inferred New Year/Christmas RTH closures
calendar.scope: fixed-date New Year/Christmas closures, including Monday observance; Friday before Saturday New Year remains regular, corroborated by 390 native 2021-12-31 RTH minute records; other unverified holidays remain unavailable

exposure: prior v2 engineering outcomes have been inspected; no holdout or profitability claim

gamma.KG1: largest absolute signed gamma strike; same-time NQ/QQQ mapping; inferred key-gamma node, not proprietary KG1
gamma.expiry: 0DTE if quoted; otherwise nearest listed expiry explicitly identified as a front-expiry approximation
gamma.inventory_assumption: call OI positive, put OI negative; model sign convention, not observed dealer inventory
gamma.option_model: European Black-Scholes, r=q=0, midquote implied volatility, 100 shares/contract
gamma.quote_availability: minute label plus 60 seconds; completed QQQ and NQ minute prices only

macro.model: equal mean of signed initial-release z scores: payroll positive, CPI negative; 12 prior initial observations
macro.output: research context only; not proprietary C-score or an entry

purpose: recreate strategy conditions from sources, excluding personal execution records

pzone.clock: historical minute-bar training only, prior dates; live anchor uses event-time bars
pzone.distance: maximum up/down move from anchor to 16:00 divided by pre-anchor 60-minute range
pzone.live_scale: current completed pre-anchor 60-minute range; quarter-point outward rounding
pzone.target: frozen anchor price; support and resistance evaluated only toward anchor
pzone.volume_filter: historical session volume at least median of prior training sessions
